blocks.title: Faithful first, additions off.
blocks.lead: The first time you switch it on, the phone behaves like an N9. Everything the N9 didn’t have is optional and starts switched off. Each addition sits in Settings on the page of what it changes, with a live preview of that part of the phone at the top.
